newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Inchcape to list marketing services unit.
newsitem.headline: Inchcape to list marketing services unit.

text.p: Trading group Inchcape Berhad said on Monday it would seek a separate listing for its marketing services businesses through the creation of a new Singapore incorporated holding company.

The company said in a statement issued with its 1996 financial results the demerger would result in two highly focused business involved with motor vehicle distribution and financing, and marketing services covering consomer, healthcare and industrial products.
"The two businesses are quite distinct from each other," the statement said.
Shares of the marketing services company would be distributed to shareholders pro rata to their existing holdings, it said.
More details of the proposed listing, on the main board of the Stock Exchange of Singapore, would be issued in due course.
